notes:
Overview: Barrowfield Heritage Authority runs regional government archives + emergency historical records. Interested in Private (air-gapped) deployment for classified archival search and an operations chat assistant for emergency coordinators. Primary ask: tight control of model artifacts and no external telemetry.

Key constraints / must-haves (from security review):
- Air-gapped deployment; no outbound connectivity from inference nodes.
- Model updates via signed, vendor-supplied packages delivered on media (USB) and validated by HSM.
- Full audit logging with 10-year retention for select routes.
- Integration with existing SSO (SAML) + on-prem KMS.
- Data residency: canonical records must never leave national data center.
- ISO27001 certification preferred; FIPS requirement for crypto ops.

Technical requirements / target SLAs:
- Primary workload: secure_document_search (RAG) for scanned gov docs + summarization for briefings. Secondary: on-call chat assistant for emergency ops.
- Latency target: P95 < 500ms for search queries at 20 QPS sustained (batching acceptable if controlled).
- Throughput: 15-30 concurrent search flows during peak.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — procurement favors predictable committed pricing (Dedicated/Private licensing).
- Model preferences: open models preferred (LLMs that can be licensed and shipped), quantized variants acceptable. Must support reproducible seeds, deterministic decoding options for audits.
